results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

results.title: Your Vision-Language-Action Model Already Has Attention Heads For Path Deviation Detection
results.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for predicting semantic actions in navigation tasks, demonstrating the ability to reason over complex linguistic instructions and visual contexts. However, they are fundamentally hindered by visual-reasoning hallucinations that lead to trajectory deviations. Addressing this issue has conventionally required training external critic modules or relying on complex uncertainty heuristics. In this work, we discover that monitoring a few attention heads within a frozen VLA model can accurately detect path deviations without incu…

findings.point: VLA驾驶模型采用推理阶段+基于扩散的轨迹解码器架构，但缺乏在不重新训练情况下重定向注意力至安全关键参与者的机制
findings.evidence: 论文提出VLA驾驶模型耦合推理阶段与扩散轨迹解码器，但无法在推理时直接重定向注意力至安全关键交通参与者；研究了在Alpamayo-R1的Qwen3-VL骨干网络上对检测器定位的交通参与者视觉token施加有界加性pre-softmax注意力偏置
findings.attention: 中 - 新提出的推理时注意力引导方法，针对VLA驾驶安全关键问题
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ - 解决VLA驾驶模型推理时安全注意力重定向的实用问题，架构相关性强

findings.point: VLA模型内部已存在可用于路径偏差检测的注意力头，视觉推理幻觉导致轨迹偏差是核心瓶颈
findings.evidence: VLA模型在导航任务中展现强语义动作预测潜力，但受视觉推理幻觉导致轨迹偏差阻碍；发现模型已有注意力头可用于路径偏差检测，无需训练外部检测器
findings.attention: 中 - 揭示VLA模型内在注意力机制可用于偏差检测，减少外部模块依赖
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ - 发现VLA模型固有注意力头功能，为无额外训练的偏差检测提供新范式

results.snippet: In this technical report, we detail our first-place solution for the 2024 Waymo Open Dataset Challenge's semantic segmentation track. We significantly enhanced the performance of Point Transformer V3 on the Waymo benchmark by implementing cutting-edge, plug-and-play training and inference technologies. Notably, our advanced version, Point Transformer V3 Extreme, leverages multi-frame training and a no-clipping-point policy, achieving substantial gains over the original PTv3 performance. Additionally, employing a straightforward model ensemble strategy further boosted our results. This approac…

results.title: BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale
results.snippet: We introduce BridgeData V2, a large and diverse dataset of robotic manipulation behaviors designed to facilitate research on scalable robot learning. BridgeData V2 contains 60,096 trajectories collected across 24 environments on a publicly available low-cost robot. BridgeData V2 provides extensive task and environment variability, leading to skills that can generalize across environments, domains, and institutions, making the dataset a useful resource for a broad range of researchers. Additionally, the dataset is compatible with a wide variety of open-vocabulary, multi-task learning methods c…

findings.point: BridgeData V2 是一个大规模机器人操作数据集，包含 60,096 条轨迹，覆盖 24 个环境，使用低成本机器人采集，旨在支持可扩展的机器人学习研究。
findings.evidence: 数据集规模：60,096 trajectories，24 environments，公开可用的低成本机器人平台；提供广泛的任务与环境变异性，有助于跨环境、跨域泛化技能的学习。
findings.attention: 中：作为机器人学习领域的大规模公开数据集被引用，但候选块未给出引用数/下载量等量化热度信号。
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：大规模、多环境、低成本平台采集，对 VLA 训练数据扩展高度相关；权威性为预印本，建议关注后续同行评审版本与社区采用度。

findings.point: 2025 年基础模型透明度指数显示，头部基础模型开发商的透明度整体下降（平均分从 58 降至 40），训练数据、训练算力及部署后使用/影响最为不透明。
findings.evidence: FMTI 2025 评估了 Alibaba、DeepSeek、xAI 等公司；平均透明度得分 40/100，较 2024 年 58 大幅下降；数据获取、使用数据、监控指标新增考核。
findings.authority: arXiv cs.AI 预印本（第三版年度报告）
findings.attention: 高：年度权威透明度基准报告，覆盖头部厂商，社区与政策关注度高。
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：直接反映 VLA 所依赖的基础模型生态在数据/算力/部署透明度上的系统性缺口，对政策合规与供应链风险评估具参考价值。

findings.point: Waymo Open Dataset 2024 语义分割挑战赛冠军方案 Point Transformer V3 Extreme 采用多帧训练与无裁剪点策略，显著提升点云感知基准性能。
findings.evidence: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 语义分割榜单夺冠；基于 PTv3 引入 multi-frame training 与 no-clipping-point policy，并通过模型集成进一步提升。
findings.authority: arXiv cs.CV 预印本，Waymo 官方挑战赛一等奖技术报告
findings.attention: 中：自动驾驶感知基准的 SOTA 进展，但属点云分割任务，与 VLA 端到端动作生成关联间接。
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：展示大规模多模态基准上的最新感知技术路线，可为 VLA 视觉编码器改进提供参考，但非直接针对动作策略。

key_datasets.recommendation: ★★★★☆：直接服务于 VLA 数据饥渴问题，建议纳入训练数据混合策略并跟踪后续维护版本。

open_problems: 基础模型训练数据、算力与部署后影响的透明度系统性缺失（FMTI 2025 指出平均分仅 40），阻碍 VLA 合规审计与供应链风险管控。
大规模机器人数据集（如 BridgeData V2）虽缓解数据稀缺，但跨本体、跨任务、跨域泛化的统一基准与评测协议仍不成熟。
感知端（如 Waymo 语义分割 SOTA）与动作策略端的联合优化缺乏统一基准，VLA 端到端训练中的视觉-动作对齐机制仍为开放问题。

### 1.2 热点综述
- **推理时干预与安全对齐**：从“训练时对齐”转向“推理时注意力引导”，无需重训练即可重定向安全关键注意力 [8]，体现**增量**创新方向。
- **模型内在机制挖掘**：发现 VLA 内部注意力头天然具备路径偏差检测能力 [9]，挑战“必须外挂检测器”的假设，降低系统复杂度。
- **仿真基准竞技与任务适配**：BEHAVIOR 2025 冠军方案 [12] 验证了 VLA 在长时程、多任务仿真环境下的任务适配潜力。
- **推理效率工程化**：BLURR [11] 等低资源推理方案回应真机部署算力瓶颈。
- **感知骨干网络迁移**：Waymo 冠军方案 Point Transformer V3 Extreme [26] 展示多帧点云感知 SOTA，为 VLA 视觉编码器升级提供技术溯源。
